issues.description: Potential information disclosure via revoke_error exposed to API consumers
issues.detail: The PR author explicitly raises this concern in the description. RevokeErr is surfaced verbatim to the lease lookup response. While errors 'should not' contain sensitive data, downstream secret engines (database drivers, cloud SDKs) routinely embed connection strings, hostnames, or credentials in error messages. Consider requiring a sudo capability or root token to view revoke_error, or redacting to a generic message with details only in logs.

issues.description: Public method rename FetchLeaseTimes -> FetchLeaseInfo is a breaking API change
issues.detail: FetchLeaseTimes is an exported method on ExpirationManager. Renaming it (rather than adding FetchLeaseInfo and deprecating the old name) will break any external consumer or plugin importing vault as a library. Recommend keeping FetchLeaseTimes as a thin wrapper that calls FetchLeaseInfo, marked deprecated, to preserve backward compatibility.

issues.description: namespace_path response field not declared in OpenAPI schema as required-aware
issues.detail: logical_system_paths.go declares `path` as Required: true but the handler always populates it. Meanwhile namespace_path is omitted when namespace is nil/root, yet the schema gives no indication. More importantly, no test covers the namespace_path or revoke_error response paths - only the bare `path` field assertion was added in logical_system_test.go.

issues.description: Mixed context usage in test: namespace.RootContext(t.Context()) vs nil
issues.detail: Line 2450 was changed to use t.Context() while the sibling test at 3101 still uses nil. Inconsistent. Either both should be migrated or neither. Also unclear why this particular test required the context change as part of a rename-only refactor; it conflates two changes in one diff.

issues.description: Comment 'non sensitive information' is now inaccurate given RevokeErr inclusion
issues.detail: The doc comment on FetchLeaseInfo states it fetches 'non sensitive information of a lease entry'. RevokeErr is being added to the export despite the PR author's own concern that it may contain sensitive data. The comment should be updated to honestly reflect what is and isn't included, or revoke_error gated separately.

issues.description: Path field exposed even when empty without zero-check
issues.detail: Unlike namespace_path, last_renewal, and expire_time which are conditionally set, `path` is always written to the response (even if empty string). For consistency with the existing handler pattern and to avoid empty string fields in JSON output, consider only setting path when non-empty - or document why path is always required.

review.summary: The PR cleanly renames FetchLeaseTimes to FetchLeaseInfo and adds path, namespace_path, and revoke_error to lease lookup responses. Main concerns: (1) the PR author's own security question about revoke_error exposure is unresolved and warrants gating behind elevated capability, (2) the rename of an exported method breaks library consumers without a deprecation alias, and (3) test coverage for the new namespace_path and revoke_error fields is missing. Overall a small, focused change but the security and API-compatibility questions should be addressed before merge.
